title: Payroll Processing Manual
subtitle: Employment Hero Payroll  ·  Fortnightly cycle  ·  Complete series
intro: Payroll at CTS runs on a fortnightly cycle. This manual covers that cycle end to end, from collecting payroll notes through to uploading the payment file and filing the records.
The seven parts are also published as standalone guides, so a new starter can be given only the sections that apply to them. Both are generated from the same source, so they always agree.
structure: Creating a New Pay Run  (from Video 2)
Reconciling Salaried & Full-Time Timesheets, including a worked example  (from Videos 3 and 4)
Employees Needing Manual Handling  (from Videos 3 and 5)
Reconciling & Balancing the Pay Run  (from Video 5)
structureNotes: There is no Part 4, and nothing is missing. Video 4 worked through a correction to a salaried employee, so its material sits at the end of Part 3b alongside the rest of the salaried guidance rather than in a guide of its own. The part numbers otherwise follow the source recordings, so a step here can always be traced back to the video it came from.

Reconciliation is split three ways because the rules differ sharply by employment type. Check an employee's type before applying any rule: the same hours are treated differently for a casual and a salaried employee.
